snippet.title: Star Defender 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Free: http://www.gamefools.com/pc-games/star-defender-2.html

Engage yourself in this space shooter adventure, as you destroy the armies of the invaders and save the galaxy. With more than 100 levels, 30 unique enemies, and 7 bosses, it's a fight for your life. Easy to use mouse controls along with familiar, yet fantastic, gameplay will ensure your blasting experience is a good one. With 17 cool ship bonuses and upgrades, you may find yourself dazzled.
